subject: Quick compatibility screen request — Vendora
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir@vendora.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-14T09:12:03-07:00
Subject: Quick technical screen before demo — Vendora

Hi Aditya,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and are excited to see Redwood in action. Before scheduling a full product demo we typically do a 15-minute technical compatibility check so we can make the most of the demo (network, data flow, auth). Can someone from your team do a short call tomorrow or Friday morning PT? Our engineer (Priya) will join.

High level: we run an EU-hosted service with some US endpoints; want to confirm region compatibility and data retention options. Attaching a tiny network diagram.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, Vendora
[attachment: vendora-net.png (image/png)]

Hi Samir — thanks for reaching out and welcome! I looped in Irene (our solutions engineer) who can run a brief 15-minute compatibility check.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 6/14 3:00pm–3:15pm PT
- Fri 6/15 9:00am–9:15am PT
- Fri 6/15 11:00am–11:15am PT

If any of these work, reply with the preferred slot and we’ll send a calendar invite. If you need earlier, say the word and I’ll try to make it happen.

Cheers,

Date: 2028-06-14T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before demo — Vendora

Hi Samir / Priya — Irene here, Solutions Engineer at Redwood. Happy to run the 15-minute compatibility check. A couple quick asks so we can be efficient:

- Can you confirm which endpoints contain customer data and which are just control-plane (API keys, webhooks)?
- Do you have an allowlist or firewall rules we should be aware of?
- What models / latency expectations are you evaluating (low-latency chat vs batch embeddings)?

I can take Fri 6/15 at 9:00am PT — sending a calendar invite momentarily. I’ll attach a short pre-call checklist (network ports, sample request sizes) that Priya can glance at. If 9am doesn’t work, pick another slot from Aditya’s list.

Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9876543210

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
[attachment: redwood-env-checklist.pdf]

From: Samir Khatri <samir@vendora.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@vendora.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T15:03:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before demo — Vendora

Irene — 9:00am PT on Friday works for us. Quick answers inline:

- Endpoints: our EU cluster (api.eu.vendora.com) stores customer data; control-plane (auth.vendora.com) is in us-east.
- Firewall: we allow outbound HTTPS to *.redwood.ai on ports 443 and 8443.
- Models: primarily low-latency chat for a customer-facing assistant, target 200–500ms token latency.

Priya attached an internal network snippet for reference.

See you Friday.

—Samir
[attachment: vendora-internal-net-snippet.png]
